title: Social signals: organisations' public posts, by link

provenance.by: sources/social/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: Organisations only, official interfaces only, by link. Bluesky: robots.txt of the public API allows crawling it and asks for backoff on 429; the Terms of Service (14 Aug 2025) leave each post's content with its author, so we store link and metadata only and credit the organisation. Mastodon: mastodon.social's terms (effective 2026-08-31) say whoever owns the content retains ownership and allow API access; its robots.txt disallows only /media_proxy/, /interact/ and a domain-blocks path. Licence on each post: the platform's terms, holder the organisation. Not reviewed by a person.

about: Links to recent public posts (last 30 days) by the official accounts of organisations (câmaras, public bodies, venues, organisers, news outlets, companies) listed in register/social-accounts.json. Each record is the post's public web address plus metadata: who, when, which topics and places its text matched, language, whether it has media. The post text and media are not stored: open the link, or use the platform's own embed, to see the post. Every post stays its author's content under the platform's terms; show it by link, credited to the organisation. A signal to check, not a verified fact. Never a private person's account.
